disclaimer: Authorized, read-only assessment of HTTP response headers. This report does not guarantee that the target is secure.

findings.explanation: The HTTPS response did not include HSTS.
findings.remediation: Send Strict-Transport-Security with an appropriate max-age on HTTPS responses.
findings.title: Strict-Transport-Security header is missing

findings.explanation: The response did not include a Content-Security-Policy header.
findings.remediation: Define a CSP appropriate for the application.
findings.title: Content-Security-Policy header is missing

findings.explanation: Missing X-Content-Type-Options may allow MIME sniffing.
findings.remediation: Set X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff on applicable responses.
findings.title: X-Content-Type-Options header is missing

findings.explanation: No X-Frame-Options or CSP frame-ancestors evaluation is performed beyond X-Frame-Options presence here.
findings.remediation: Use X-Frame-Options or CSP frame-ancestors to reduce clickjacking risk.
findings.title: X-Frame-Options header is missing

findings.remediation: No change required for basic presence review.
findings.title: Referrer-Policy header is present

limitations: Follows HTTP redirects by default (additional GET per hop); use --no-redirects for one request. No crawling beyond the redirect chain.
Only five selected response headers are evaluated for presence.
Absence or presence of a header is not a complete security assessment.
Does not inspect HTML, cookies, JavaScript, or server-side logic.
Use only on systems you own or are explicitly authorized to test.
